definitions.explanation: The amount of time spent waiting for something, such as at a restaurant, hospital, or attraction.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30{分|ぷん}です。
⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: Popular restaurants have long wait times.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: You can check the wait time on the app.

notes:
{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん} is a compound noun: ⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (waiting, from ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧) + ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time). It refers to the time spent waiting before being served or admitted.

USAGE:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: hospital waiting time
- ⟦{遊園地|ゆうえんち}→遊園地：03174_yuuenchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: theme park queue time
- ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: restaurant wait time
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}: airport wait/layover time

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {待|ま}ち{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: the wait is long
